scope: Correction to prior independent static-reviews; no prior report is rewritten.
discovery: Root identified the official PyTorch 2.8 UUID representation mismatch before the waiting campaign entered a model stage.

primary_sources.finding: The 16-byte CUuuid string is bare 8-4-4-4-12 hex, without a GPU prefix.
NVIDIA converts CUDA UUID bytes to a GPU-prefixed representation for NVML-style comparison.
The immutable ASCII UUID lookup documentation does not by itself establish that a bare UUID is rejected.

missed_by_prior_review.responsibility: This independent review did not verify the public UUID string representation against the pinned PyTorch implementation.
missed_by_prior_review.fixture_limitation: The v1 candidate fixture used GPU-test, an NVML-prefixed value that is not a complete valid UUID. Prior synthetic runtime/control fixtures did not expose the native bare representation.
missed_by_prior_review.affected_conclusion: Prior v1 no-blocking-static-finding conclusions were insufficient to establish runtime admission. v1 campaign/bundle must not be reused as executable qualified evidence.

confirmed_defects: v1 runtime_entry compared a bare Torch UUID directly with the canonical GPU-prefixed target and would reject the correct device.
v1 configure_cuda could misclassify a canonical nvidia-smi readback as a different device because the requested CUDA UUID remained bare.
v1 external original-probe validation expected a canonical string although the frozen original probe records the native bare string.

actual_nvml_comparison.interpretation: On this actual runtime both spellings resolve. The original energy-counter gap must not be attributed to NVML rejecting a bare UUID. Existing direct canonical NOT_SUPPORTED readings remain unchanged.

targeted_regression.method: A 16-byte object models the pinned CUuuid formatter; unchanged function ASTs reproduce v1 runtime/configure/probe-validator failures and verify v2 correction, including immutable original probe receipt.

scientific_limits: No actual Torch/CUDA training result is established by static review or synthetic UUID tests.
At cancellation the full matrix remained 0 of 170 and no full-budget B checkpoint had been accepted.
Historical unfavorable B evidence and unsupported physical GPU energy counters are not upgraded.
unaffected_scopes: Task-local artifact download, integrity, disk-budget, installation and owned-process cleanup reviews are independent of the UUID comparison.
Original baseline, rematerialization implementation, probe bytes and numerical training budgets are preserved.
